mapper.select: SELECT c.CARD_SEQ AS id, c.COLUMN_SEQ AS columnId, col.BOARD_SEQ AS boardId FROM TG_CARD c JOIN TG_BOARD_COLUMN col ON col.COLUMN_SEQ = c.COLUMN_SEQ WHERE c.CARD_SEQ = #{cardId}
SELECT BOARD_SEQ FROM TG_BOARD_COLUMN WHERE COLUMN_SEQ = #{columnId} FOR UPDATE
SELECT NVL(MAX(POSITION), 0) + 1000 FROM TG_CARD WHERE COLUMN_SEQ = #{columnId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TG_CARD (CARD_SEQ, COLUMN_SEQ, CARD_TITLE, CARD_DESC, POSITION, DUE_DATE, REG_DATE, UPD_DATE) VALUES (TG_CARD_SEQ.NEXTVAL, #{columnId}, #{title}, #{description,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{position}, #{dueDate,jdbcType=DATE}, SYSDATE, SYSDATE)
mapper.update: UPDATE TG_CARD SET CARD_TITLE = #{title}, CARD_DESC = #{description,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, DUE_DATE = #{dueDate,jdbcType=DATE}, COLUMN_SEQ = #{columnId}, POSITION = #{position}, UPD_DATE = SYSDATE WHERE CARD_SEQ = #{cardId}
mapper.select: SELECT CARD_SEQ AS id, POSITION AS position FROM TG_CARD WHERE COLUMN_SEQ = #{columnId} ORDER BY POSITION, CASE WHEN CARD_SEQ = #{movedCardId} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, CARD_SEQ
mapper.update: MERGE INTO TG_CARD t USING (SELECT CARD_SEQ, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY POSITION, CASE WHEN CARD_SEQ = #{movedCardId} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, CARD_SEQ) * 1000 AS NEW_POS FROM TG_CARD WHERE COLUMN_SEQ = #{columnId}) s ON (t.CARD_SEQ = s.CARD_SEQ) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET t.POSITION = s.NEW_POS WHERE t.POSITION <> s.NEW_POS
